objective: Improve source-backed scientific validation failure diagnostics, ensure the independent VizieR download directory exists, and retry transient HTTP failures without weakening fail-closed validation.

Cumulative Lifecycle Gate requires a machine-readable record for meaningful changes

baseline.status: Scientific Validation workflow could fail without printing the acquisition report's underlying error; independent VizieR output could fail when the output directory was absent.

expected_improvement: Print the acquisition JSON report when CPVS acquisition fails, preserving the original non-zero failure.
Create the independent VizieR output directory before downloading.
Retry transient VizieR transport failures with explicit connection and total timeouts.

diagnostics.before: CPVS acquisition report was not emitted in the failing step's logs.
diagnostics.after: Failure branch prints the acquisition report when present; verify in a subsequent run.

robustness.before: Independent VizieR download could target a missing directory.
robustness.after: Output root is created and curl retries transient failures.

scientific_validity.before: Source-backed evidence is required for external benchmark claims.
scientific_validity.after: Scientific validation remains fail-closed; no source evidence is fabricated and no scientific gate is bypassed.

evidence: PR CI run 38000299005: Format Check and Lint passed.
Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because the required cycle record was absent; the cycle record is added in this commit and PR checks must rerun.
Runtime Smoke Tests, Test Suite, Dependency Audit, and Build & Verify Package were skipped downstream of the failed lifecycle gate.
Source-backed CPVS acquisition and frozen historical ALeRCE reference acquisition still require successful evidence-backed reruns.

root_causes: The PR-triggered Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because the workflow source change had no machine-readable record under configs/process/cycles/.
The earlier CPVS failure's underlying external acquisition cause remains unknown until the diagnostic change is exercised by a new run.
The earlier historical ALeRCE reference acquisition experienced HTTP 504; this is not evidence of a checksum or data-integrity failure.

findings: Every meaningful workflow change must include a cumulative lifecycle record.
A diagnostic improvement does not prove the external source acquisition succeeds; rerun and inspect the acquisition report.
External benchmark and frozen-reference checks must remain fail-closed.

open_blockers: Rerun PR checks and confirm all required CI jobs pass.
Inspect a fresh CPVS acquisition report to identify the underlying external acquisition failure.
Confirm successful immutable historical ALeRCE reference verification with manifest and checksums.

knowledge_carried_forward: The v0.2.0 scientific baseline remains immutable.
Never weaken scientific gates or claim source-backed reproduction without verified source evidence.
A successful lint/format check is not equivalent to passing the full CI or scientific validation.
